nodes.label: NodeJS-CentralAppRouter (README)
nodes.rationale: Centralized App Router pattern: one shared aps-approuter serves all SAP BTP HTML5 apps rather than each app bundling its own router, reducing resource usage and centralizing auth/routing.

nodes.label: Centralized AppRouter Pattern (SAP BTP)
nodes.rationale: One shared approuter serves multiple HTML5 apps. Each app uploads to its own html5-apps-repo app-host; the central approuter uses the app-runtime plan to serve all of them. This separates routing/auth concerns from individual app deployments.
